title: Maximin Relative Improvement: Fair Learning as a Bargaining Problem
reasoning: The paper proposes a new mathematical criterion for group fairness in machine learning based on cooperative bargaining theory. While it references ethical principles such as Rawlsian and Egalitarian solutions to compare different robust optimization criteria, its focus is on mathematical optimization and statistical convergence guarantees for general predictive models, rather than benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
